add_en: It is powered by an included supply with no battery option, and suits full song structures.
add_es: Se alimenta con fuente incluida, sin opción a pila, y sirve para estructuras de canción completas.

add_en: Its 130-ohm impedance targets modern interfaces and high-end laptops, though it benefits from a dedicated amplifier.
add_es: Sus 130 ohmios van con interfaces modernas y portátiles, aunque piden amplificador.

add_en: Thick, mid-forward capture suits layered rhythm guitars and brass sections, and healthy preamplification proves mandatory.
add_es: Su captura gruesa encaja con guitarras rítmicas y vientos, y exige previo generoso.

add_en: Its touchscreen workflow stays immediate for corporate, worship and club engineers, but Dante houses need external bridging.
add_es: Su flujo es inmediato en empresa, culto y club; sin Dante hacen falta puentes.

add_en: Standard keeps the classic smoky grit, Custom adds body, and a five-year warranty backs it.
add_es: Standard guarda el grit ahumado; Custom suma cuerpo y hay cinco años de garantía.

add_en: Its waveguide controls dispersion so the stereo image holds when the listener's head moves.
add_es: Su guía de ondas mantiene la imagen estéreo firme al mover la cabeza.

add_en: Session View handles real-time clip launching; performances record into Arrangement View.
add_es: La vista Session gestiona el lanzamiento de clips en tiempo real y la grabación de interpretaciones en la vista Arrangement.

add_en: It suits minimalists and beginners, keeping attention on playing rather than operating gear.
add_es: Convence a minimalistas y principiantes al mantener la atención en tocar, no en el aparato.

add_en: No earphones ship in the box, and operation stays plug-and-play without any RF coordination from the band.
add_es: No incluye auriculares y funciona sin coordinación RF.

add_en: No battery option exists, and its roughly 20 dBA self-noise wants a decent preamp.
add_es: No admite pila, y su auto-ruido de unos 20 dBA pide un previo decente.

add_en: A 14-gauge steel chassis and Neutrik connectors help it survive tour after tour.
add_es: Su chasis de acero calibre 14 y los conectores Neutrik aguantan gira tras gira.

add_en: Solid wood opens up further with playing, and there are no onboard electronics for plugging in.
add_es: La madera sólida se abre con el uso y no hay electrónica para enchufarla.

add_en: TRS/TRRS auto-sensing mounts it on mirrorless bodies and phones, though reach stays modest for narrative work.
add_es: La detección TRS/TRRS lo adapta a cámaras y teléfonos.

add_en: With no rear lobe it avoids wall reflections and comb-filtering, and its RF condenser resists humidity.
add_es: Sin lóbulo trasero evita reflejos de pared; su condensador RF resiste humedad.

add_en: At 370 g it keeps a passive DI on the pedalboard without occupying much space.
add_es: Con 370 g mantiene una DI pasiva en la pedalera sin ocupar mucho.

add_en: Its 10:1 transformer keeps response within a decibel from 20Hz to 20kHz, and the 250 g shell survives boots.
add_es: Su transformador es 10:1 y la respuesta aguanta 20Hz–20kHz.

add_en: Closed-back isolation keeps vocal monitoring clean without bleed, and the low-end lift flatters more than it reveals.
add_es: El aislamiento cerrado evita fugas y el realce de graves adula más que revela.

add_en: It needs no phantom power or preamp, and averaging three sweeps beats a single measurement.
add_es: No necesita phantom ni previo, y promediar tres barridos mejora una sola medición.

add_en: The mass keeps heavy midfield cabinets from sliding across the floor during playback.
add_es: Su masa evita que cajas de campo medio pesadas se deslicen por el suelo.

add_en: The preamps deliver 58 dB of gain, and ScrollControl turns the unit into a monitor controller with talkback and dim.
add_es: Sus previos dan 58 dB y ScrollControl gestiona los monitores.

add_en: Two preamps give 55 dB of clean gain, with 24-bit/192 kHz conversion and direct monitoring.
add_es: Dos previos dan 55 dB limpios, con conversión de 24 bits/192 kHz y monitorización directa.

add_en: Blending it with nearfield monitors takes only a few setup steps, speeding up low-end decisions.
add_es: Fundirlo con los nearfields exige pocos pasos de ajuste.

add_en: An 80 Hz roll-off switch tames traffic and handling rumble, while 145 g keeps booms light.
add_es: El corte de 80 Hz reduce ruido de tráfico y pesa solo 145 g.

add_en: Pressing ANALYZE yields a Smart Preset tailored to the source, on tracks or a full mix.
add_es: Pulsar ANALYZE genera un Smart Preset ajustado a la fuente o mezcla completa.

add_en: It adds a -20 dB pad and +10 dB boost on the quarter-inch output.
add_es: Suma pad de -20 dB y boost de +10 dB al 1/4.

add_en: A reinforced chassis anchors it to the studio at 3.7 kg, and there is no sampling engine.
add_es: El chasis reforzado la ancla al estudio y no hay sampling.
